sourceContext.inspection: Original PBO hash matches recorded intake; prior source intent remains referenced. No fresh whole-source review or copied code. This is an independent extension of existing CBE terrain planning, not a claimed upstream route algorithm.

finding: Current CortexAirAttackPlan forms one pattern axis and uniformly lifts its three stages. Unsafe early join or required lift beyond the platform envelope rejects that only route. It has no alternate bearing attempt even where the same weapon pattern could pass beside relief. The build-out ledger correctly retains no general3Droute search; this selected extension does not close that broader gap.
implementation: Keep original weapon/station/loaded magazine, target belief, sampled speed/heights, capture radii and attack minimum. Original viable route succeeds after one unchanged terrain candidate.

Only after terrain failure, and only with no observed AA positions, try whole-pattern rotations of -35 then+35degrees around the same believed target. All three points rotate together, retaining target-relative distances, attack-line crossing/broadside geometry and leg lengths. Intercepts skip terrain fallback. Known-AA plans retain their original defensive axis and single attempt.

Each candidate resets only local clearance/lift results and starts from the original stage altitudes; it repeats the same real aircraft join, early-climb refusal, three lateral lines and platform lift limits. No random height/weapon reroll or relaxed clearance. Accept first passing candidate; all failures return the original empty-plan policy.

Sample count is cumulative across attempts. Plan stores chosen offset and attempts, copied into existing air-attack job. Existing operation/flight/weapon/pilot/friendly-safety/final mutation boundaries retain command ownership. No new worker, controller, native movement site, lease/deadline or global setting.
cost: At most3 terrain corridors, each bounded to330 lateral/interior samples, <=990 across3, plus <=9 endpoint terrain reads. Conclusive early-join or over-limit lift failure stops all remaining loops in that candidate. Passing candidates retain the complete sample set. Adjacent legs reuse the same vertex terrain height only inside that candidate; no cross-candidate/plan cache. Original successes retain one corridor. This is bounded plan-creation work, not a measured whole-mod5%median/10%p95 result; alternate failed-plan probes may still cost more than the former single-candidate policy.

queryCostReduction20261028.implementation: Keep monotone rejection and break lateral/sample/leg loops without changing candidate order, clearance, lift limits, successful-route samples or accepted stage heights. Retain the previous endpoint terrain inside each candidate, reducing endpoint reads6 to3 per complete candidate. Rejected candidate diagnostics are intentionally partial and are discarded; cumulative sample count records actual probes.
